lore.intro:
Coolant Row. The pumps have been louder
lately. Nobody says so on record.

terminals.text:
SURVEY ADDENDUM, UNFILED
The row has five hatches. The count says six.
The sixth is behind the filters. Walked it once,
drew a map. Walked it again against the map.
The map was wrong in a way I could not mark:
every corridor was where I drew it, and two of
them cross where neither has a junction.
Recommend: do not draw another map.

MAINT LOG 2280.11
Crewman SURVEYOR S-6 walked Coolant Row
end to end.
Counted five hatches going. Counted six coming back.
Recommend rest rotation for SURVEYOR S-6.

MAINT TICKET 4471
Coolant flow, east tail: 210 l/min rated,
212 measured, 209 after the bend.
Where do three liters a minute GO?
Status: closed. Reason: rounding.

MAINT LOG, PUMP BAY ONE
Coolant pressure holds steady at spec, checked
at the gauge. Flow rate does not match the
pressure. It should. The math connecting the two
numbers has not changed since the pumps were
rated. Checked that too.
Filed under: recalibrate flow sensor. Sensor
recalibrated. Numbers held.

MAINT TICKET 4488 — FOLLOW-UP TO SURVEYOR S-6 LOG
Re-walked Coolant Row end to end, count taken
twice. Five hatches, both times, both directions.
Schematic on file: five hatches. Schematic
checksum does not match the schematic filed
eleven months ago. Nobody has edited this file.
Status: closed, no fault found. Recommend against
opening it again.

SCRATCHED NEAR THE FLOOR VENT
tally marks, forty-one of them, then nothing
someone was counting seconds. or minutes. or
hatches. whoever it was stopped at forty-one and
left the chalk on the ledge.

FILTER SWAP PROCEDURE, POSTED
Isolate the loop before pulling a filter: the
isolation valve takes the loose handwheel racked
by the manifold. One wheel serves the row — the
same square drive runs the armory annex pressure
hatch at the east tail. Engineering never issued
a second wheel. Asked twice. Bring it back.

red.gate_prompt: PRESSURE HATCH SEALED - VALVE WHEEL REQUIRED
